Application Data.NAME: Electra Supply Co.
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Electra Supply Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Electra Supply Co. specializes in the distribution and retail of electrical equipment and supplies, including wiring, circuit breakers, lighting solutions, and safety devices. Our operations encompass both retail sales and online ordering, allowing for a wide reach in the electrical supply market. We are committed to maintaining high standards of quality and safety, sourcing our products from reputable manufacturers and adhering to all applicable industry regulations. To protect our inventory which exceeds $500,000, we have implemented a professionally monitored alarm system to mitigate theft risks. Additionally, we offer repair services for certain products, ensuring that we maintain professional liability coverage to safeguard against potential service-related claims.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Industry-Specific Restrictions
To mitigate underwriting risk, the following restrictions apply
specifically to office supplies and equipment businesses:
• Alarm System Requirement: An operational, professionally monitored alarm system is
mandatory for businesses with inventory exceeding $500,000 to reduce theft and burglary
losses.
• Professional Liability Coverage: Repair service providers must maintain professional
liability (errors and omissions) coverage to address potential claims arising from faulty repairs
or service errors.
• Restriction on Sourcing from High-Risk Overseas Suppliers: Businesses sourcing
office equipment or supplies from countries with known quality control issues or geopolitical
instability (e.g., certain regions with frequent product recalls or counterfeit goods) will be
subject to additional scrutiny or declination. This restriction is critical because poor-quality
imports increase product liability exposure and claims frequency.
